dict.string: CareSphere connects to Bluetooth heart-rate monitors — including Garmin watches broadcasting heart rate — to stream live vitals.
CareSphere uses the camera for video coffee circles and telehealth visits.
CareSphere locks your health data behind Touch ID / Face ID.
CareSphere reads heart rate, blood oxygen, blood pressure, and workout summaries from Apple Health after you approve. It never writes health data.

CareSphere transfers only selected encrypted records directly between nearby phones on your private Wi-Fi or hotspot, and can search a local Kiwix library. No hosted server is used for device transfers.
CareSphere includes your location only when you choose to share SOS details. Nothing is sent automatically.
CareSphere uses the microphone for video coffee circles and telehealth visits.
CareSphere counts your daily steps to encourage gentle, healthy movement.
